key_insight: Omni demonstrates "Context Unrolling": the model explicitly reasons across multiple modal representations (text, images, video, 3D, hidden states) in an internal iterative step before producing predictions, enabling richer cross-modal aggregation and more faithful multimodal reasoning.
problem_solved: Addresses how to unify and faithfully reason across heterogeneous modalities so complementary and partial signals (e.g., image + text + 3D) can be combined without losing intermediate modality-specific structure or relying on brittle ad-hoc fusion.
method: Train a single unified multimodal model on diverse modalities (text, images, video, 3D geometry, and hidden representations).
Introduce Context Unrolling: an explicit internal reasoning loop that propagates and refines modality-specific representations before final decoding.
Aggregate cross-modal information via attention/aggregation modules during unrolling to produce a coherent shared multimodal representation used for prediction.
impact: Enables practitioners to build models that better exploit complementary multimodal information for more accurate and faithful outputs, improving robustness and interpretability in multimodal tasks and downstream applications.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: modality inputs → modality encoders → Context Unrolling loop → decoder/output
Icon row: small icons for text, image, video, 3D and hidden-state tokens feeding into the unrolling module
Before vs After chart: comparison of naive fusion vs Context Unrolling on task accuracy/faithfulness
Attention heatmap or flow visualization showing how information is reweighted and aggregated across modalities during unrolling
paper_authors: Ceyuan Yang, Zhijie Lin, Yang Zhao, Fei Xiao, Hao He
